mcpServers.title: FilmCraft
mcpServers.description: Connect to the local FilmCraft desktop app for visible project inspection, editing, and export.

interface.shortDescription: Storyboard, generate, narrate, subtitle, edit, and export videos
interface.longDescription: FilmCraft coordinates a complete local video workflow: storyboard a concept, generate images and videos through the signed-in Nexts Auto routes, create ElevenLabs narration through the configured backend Voice route, prepare reviewed subtitles, and assemble an editable FilmCraft project with a final export. Production files stay in the current Nexts temporary workspace and are never placed on the Desktop by default.
defaultPrompt: Create a short product video with FilmCraft, including generated visuals, ElevenLabs narration, subtitles, and a local export.
Continue the previous FilmCraft production from its existing assets and export an editable project and final video.
